description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 5 (Contamination) of planning consent reference 18399/APP/2026/586 dated 05/05/26 (Additional access into the site at the front, with widening of the existing access road with fencing; erection of a canopy and welfare unit to the front; lowered concrete yard area with 3 x dock doors and wheel guides; 1 x level loading door; installation of fencing and bollards, and an additional waste area).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The submitted details fail to satisfactorily demonstrate that the approved remediation scheme has been fully implemented. In particular, the information provided does not include a comprehensive Verification Report confirming the completion and effectiveness of all remedial works undertaken on site, together with appropriate validation results, waste transfer documentation (where applicable), and evidence that the site is suitable for its approved end use. As such, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that risks to human health, controlled waters, property, or the wider environment arising from land contamination have been adequately addressed. The application is therefore contrary to Policy DMEI 11 and 12 of the London Borough of Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2: Development Management Policies (2020).
